card.title: Everything Is Policy
card.instruction: Treat every personal choice as evidence of a larger system. Connect exceptions, habits, and coincidences until they become institutional doctrine.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You apologised before making tea. Is that our conflict-resolution procedure now?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yesterday I made tea because you looked sad. Nothing broke.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then sadness qualifies as damage. I'll amend the procedure before either of us has to smash anything.

mechanism: A converts apology and tea into a conflict procedure, then expands its definition of damage when sadness supplies a counterexample.
confusable: Unlike interpreting only hidden feelings, A makes personal events into a coherent institutional doctrine and amends it for exceptions.
comparison: The tea alternative revises a qualifying category; the lunch alternative moves from availability allocation to reservation entitlement.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
